== Biography ==
Agnes was born in 1618. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-991|James Glasgow]].

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Agnes Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and James Swan on 12 May 1666 at Kirknewton and East Calder.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 690/10 / 55; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Agnes Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Agnas Glasgow and William Anderson on 5 July 1666 at Longformacus.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 750/10 / 79; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Agnes Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and Patrik Paul on 8 July 1670 at Kirknewton and East Calder.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 690/10 / 64; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Agnes Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and William Thomsone on 15 December 1681 at Carstairs.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 633/10 / 66; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
